_comment: The four GA4 properties, as code. ga4-config.mjs applies 'outcomes' (marked as key events) and 'dimensions' (event-scoped custom dimensions) to each property; ga4-rollup.mjs reports across them. 'match' is the text a session source must contain to count as coming from that site. Exactly one site is the hub, whose project_click events are joined to arrivals on the others. Run ga4-rollup.mjs --discover to re-check property ids.

dimensions.name: Project
dimensions.description: Which project a funnel event is about (etu, parkers, landscaping)

dimensions.name: Placement
dimensions.description: Where on the site the link sits (projects_hero, home_strip...)

dimensions.name: CTA
dimensions.description: Which button: primary, secondary, wishlist, intent, feature, card

dimensions.name: Page context
dimensions.description: Page type: home, projects, article, page, archive

dimensions.name: Signup source
dimensions.description: Which subscribe form a sign_up came from

dimensions.name: CTA location
dimensions.description: Where the CTA sits on the page
